# NIST AI RMF Static RAG Demo

> Dual-readable Markdown extracts of NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1) and the Generative AI Profile (NIST.AI.600-1), plus a static hybrid retrieval demo with section citations. **Not official NIST output.** Cite the official DOIs for normative use: https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1 and https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
>
> Demo home: https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/
> This corpus is separate from the CoSAI SRF knowledge graph and from the TACIP orphan at /nist/.

## How agents should use this corpus

- **Authoritative quote / cite:** fetch the clean Markdown sources below, then quote by section path / heading anchor. Prefer the official NIST PDF/DOI when the answer is normative.
- **Scenario routing:** use the RAG demo (`?q=` or `&format=json`) to find candidate sections, then **verify** against the cited Markdown (or official PDF) before answering.
- **Do not** treat retrieval snippets or fused scores as official NIST guidance.
- **Applicability:** NIST.AI.600-1 supplements and does not replace NIST.AI.100-1. When both appear, state that distinction.

## Clean Markdown sources

- [AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1)](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/nist-ai-100-1.md): Structured extract of the Framework Core (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE), trustworthiness characteristics, and framing risk.
- [Generative AI Profile (NIST.AI.600-1)](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/nist-ai-600-1.md): Twelve GAI risk categories and suggested actions mapped to AI RMF subcategories.
- [Attribution](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/sources/ATTRIBUTION.md): Official URLs, versions, public-domain notice, conversion notes.
- [Full concatenated sources](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/llms-full.txt): Both Markdown sources in one file.

## Structured retrieval data

- [Corpus manifest](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/corpus-manifest.json): Document IDs, versions, embedding method, chunk count.
- [Chunks](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/chunks.json): Structure-aware chunks with section_path, anchor, topics, related SP 800-53 IDs.
- [Graph edges](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/data/graph-edges.json): Lightweight relatedness (functions, profile→base, curated 800-53 IDs). COSAiS overlay IDs are intentionally absent (pending public drafts).

## RAG demo / retrieval endpoint

- [RAG demo UI](https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/): Browser hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense vectors, RRF fusion, citations).
- JSON mode: `https://aisharedresponsibility.com/nist-ai-rmf/?q=YOUR+QUERY&format=json`
- Optional filters: `doc=nist-ai-100-1|nist-ai-600-1`, `fn=govern|map|measure|manage`, `genai=1`

## Official NIST publications

- [NIST.AI.100-1 PDF](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.100-1.pdf)
- [NIST.AI.600-1 PDF](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.600-1.pdf)
- [AI RMF program page](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework)
